_comment: AVA Logistics tarifi — QORALAMA (status: draft). MODEL — EGA QARORI 2026-10-07 kech (AVA_DECIDED, N=1 qarorini bekor qiladi): 6 zona × 5 vazn pog'onasi (≤1/≤3/≤5/≤10/≤20 kg), butun so'm, ega jadvali aynan. ZONE_2/3/5 narxi bor, lekin matritsada hali yo'nalish yo'q. MAKSIMAL VAZN CHEGARASI YO'Q (ega qarori 2026-10-07) — limits.maxWeightG yozilmaydi; 20 kg dan og'ir posilka har BOSHLANGAN kg uchun extraPerKg bilan narxlanadi (tariff.js basePriceFor: ceil), +1 kg — ega qarori 2026-10-07 kech: ZONE_0 2 500, ZONE_1 6 000, ZONE_4 8 500; ZONE_2/3/5 — null (matritsada yo'q, faol qilishga to'sqinlik qilmaydi). Ichki ulushlar — ega qarori o'sha kun: platforma 20 % (platformMarginBps 2000), qolgan 80 % LEG'larga 25/50/25 (legShareBps yig'indisi 10000 — tizim talabi). limits.maxDimCm 150 / maxSumDimCm 300 — INFERRED (BTS namunasi), ega hali tasdiqlamagan: «yo'q» desa olib tashlanadi. Zona matritsasi pilot uchun INFERRED (hujjat §10: Xorazm ichi → Urganch ↔ Toshkent). volumetricDivisor 6000 — BTS benchmark (BTS_CONFIRMED). `node functions_demand/tools/seed_logistics_tariff.js --write` bilan yoziladi (standart: dry-run; draft to'liq almashtiriladi).
notes: Zona ma'nosi kodga yozilmaydi — matritsa yagona manba (D-2). declaredValue.feeBps=100 (1%) — BTS_CONFIRMED (L15), AVA qarori kutiladi.
